_README: The Moves/Shots counters visible in the panel of a lasertanksolutions.blogspot.com screenshot, hand-read.  Everything else about a post is derived -- tools/sprites.py labels every tile from the game's own committed graphics -- but the panel is TextOut with the system font (LTANK.C:563), so no composite of Game.BMP can draw it and nothing in this repo says what it says.  Hand input, therefore committed, therefore never re-derived: see bench/README.md.  Keyed 'Collection:level'; tools/harvest.py bank folds it into the bank, and a level absent from here banks moves/shots as null.  These are the BLOGGER's counts, not the .ghs record -- LaserTank 10 is 179/52 here against the record's 124/55.
